title: GET /api/pairing/clients/{client_id}/effective
description: Everything the device page needs: access, profile, own area, adjustments and the effective value of every catalog rule with source and reason (not applicable rules included, value null). Also the answer of PUT/DELETE …/overrides/{rule_key} and PUT …/own-area.

own_area_id.description: Own area of the device; null = none.

rules.description: Rule key -> effective rule, every catalog rule.

remote_pin_source.description: Origin of the effective remote PIN; has_remote_pin = the device's own PIN.

scene_hints.description: Released scenes and scripts with targets this device may not switch (docs/enforcement.md §2 step 4), with its own area and adjustments. Empty when Home Assistant is not reachable. At most 50.

hub_remote_now.description: Right after this state the device's effective Home Assistant access is Hub only and its remote access is on: it holds the read-only key because of remote access (the admin page warns). Never true on tvos, android_tv, watchos or wearos (Hub only resolves to checked there). Missing on older hubs = unknown.

hub_remote_at.description: The earliest later end (UTC) of a device adjustment or of the guest access after which the device becomes Hub only with remote access; null when hub_remote_now is true or no end leads there.
